description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and collaborators publish TBBR to support detection of rooftop thermal bridges from drone imagery. The dataset contains 926 aligned images and 6,927 manually drawn annotations covering six building blocks in central Karlsruhe, recorded on 19 March 2019 between 07:00 and 08:00. Each NumPy image has 2,680 by 3,370 pixels and five channels: blue, green, red, thermal and derived height. Training and test annotations use COCO JSON, with STAC metadata. Zenodo provides compressed archives free under CC BY 4.0. Derived heat-loss features could inform retrofit and building simulations with model-energyplus after a separate physical calibration. A caveat is that overlapping views repeatedly depict the same buildings and thermal bridges. Only visually identifiable bridges were labelled, and some visible bridges remain unannotated. Image temperatures also depend on the stated emissivity and weather conditions. No imagery was downloaded or detector performance reproduced.
